nodes.label: Quota Exhausted UX
nodes.rationale: When Gemini free-tier quota hits 100% or the API rate-limiter trips, show a friendly localized amber 'please wait' card with a retry countdown and manual Try Again, preserving the uploaded resume so the user does not re-upload; real bugs still show the red failure card.

nodes.label: ProviderRateLimitError
nodes.rationale: A RuntimeError marker subclass carrying provider + status_code, raised when each provider's wrapped message matches a shared 429/quota/rate-limit/exceeded regex.

nodes.label: error_code Field
nodes.rationale: Backend structured error classification: add a nullable error_code String(50) column so the frontend can distinguish a quota pause from a real bug; set 'rate_limited' when exc is ProviderRateLimitError, else None.

nodes.label: Middleware 429 Rate-Limit
nodes.rationale: The rate-limit middleware returns HTTPException(429); the frontend surfaces it by checking res.status === 429.

nodes.label: Wait & Retry Amber Card
nodes.rationale: A useLanguage-driven amber branch between failed and error states in AnalysisResults.tsx with a live retry countdown, preserved resume, and a manual Try Again Now button; red card remains for real bugs.

nodes.label: Quota i18n Key Group
nodes.rationale: Add a quota group to en.json and fa.json (Persian), then regenerate the typed union via scripts/gen-i18n-types.mjs to keep src/types/i18n.ts type-checking.

nodes.label: isRateLimitError Helper
nodes.rationale: Frontend helper checking status === 429 or a message matching /quota|rate limit|exceeded/i, shared across upload and analysis failure handling.

nodes.label: Retry Semantics (Re-Post New Analysis)
nodes.rationale: A true 'retry same analysis' is unavailable because the backend creates a fresh Analysis row per POST /resumes/{id}/analyze; on retry, call POST again to create a new analysis and set analysisId to the new id, preserving the uploaded resume and re-running scoring.
